diagnosis_in.chosen: Fix _rect_clear to correctly compute minimum distance to robot body rectangle
diagnosis_in.direction: Rewrite _rect_clear to compute horizontal distance as max(0, rx - x_max, x_min - rx) and vertical as max(0, ry - y_max, y_min - ry), then clr = sqrt(ddx² + ddy²). This ensures accurate proximity detection to body edges.
